title: Chanvoy wait_inbox_follow_v1 Parameters
description: Strict parameters for one process-held wait on any direct message to this bot. Stream records use wait_inbox_follow_v1.event, not wait_follow_v1.event. There is no team, channel, or username selector.

inbox-cursor.description: Opaque versioned inbox cursor. Not a Mattermost post id. Encoded form is capped at 32 KiB. The decoded catalog is never a wire field.

timeout_secs.description: Required positive u64 duration. The absolute deadline starts at RPC entry and covers subscribe, catalog, baselines, ownership, bind, and block.

contains.description: Optional case-sensitive literal body substring. Empty is refused at runtime.

pattern.description: Optional Rust-regex body pattern. Combines with contains using logical AND.

mention.description: When true, only posts that mention this bot complete the wait. Logical AND with contains and pattern. Default false/absent. Non-matches are not tips.

oneOf.description: Opaque versioned inbox cursor. Not a Mattermost post id. Encoded form is capped at 32 KiB. The decoded catalog is never a wire field.

after.description: Exclusive inbox cursor from a prior inbox result. Not a Mattermost post id. Null or absent means subscribe-then-catalog tip-at-arm.

oneOf.description: Opaque wait id from a prior wait_already_active conflict. Inbox-to-inbox compare-and-replace only.
